objective: Let session-file mode of assignment reports under the pi host list the pi-workflow Assignments it cannot read, by passing them to piRecordReports.
scope: Work only in /home/user/holyagent-0.3.0-launcher. In packages/runtime/src/cli/assignment.ts near line 249, the session-file branch keeps only agents with the PI_AGENT_PREFIX (pi:) before calling piRecordReports, so pi-workflow: agents never reach it and are not listed. Change the filter to keep agents starting with PI_AGENT_PREFIX or PI_WORKFLOW_AGENT_PREFIX (import the constant from where PI_AGENT_PREFIX comes). piRecordReports in packages/runtime/src/cli/report.ts already lists a pi-workflow agent as <agent id> not in a session file.
Add one case to packages/runtime/tests/pi-reports-e2e.test.ts (session-file test) asserting that a dispatched Assignment recorded as pi-workflow:<run>/<id> appears in that listing.
constraints: Edit only the ownership paths; no version-control writes and no edits under .git/ or .holyagent/.
Run bunx --no-install mise run build, then bunx --no-install mise run verify; report each exit code (echo $?) and the test counts.
Start each evidence line with the criterion text, then a colon.
